subject: ECHT (Marchioni & Cappelli extended-channel Hall thruster) on N2 as Hall validation evidence

basis.audit_verdict: NOT USABLE AS AN INDEPENDENT, SCOREABLE VALIDATION DATASET WITHOUT FORCED ASSUMPTIONS. Usable at most as a supporting, pre-registered qualitative/semi-quantitative check (sustainment at 180-220 V, 2.06 mg/s; I_d magnitude and its decrease with coil current; thrust ~20-23 mN) with every forced assumption carried as a declared layer-1 nuisance, never as a promotion-deciding criterion on its own.
sources: S1 Marchioni & Cappelli, J. Appl. Phys. 130, 053306 (2021), doi:10.1063/5.0048283 (paywalled; abstract only, via Crossref)
S2 F. Marchioni, MSc thesis, Politecnico di Torino / Stanford, 2020, https://webthesis.biblio.polito.it/14618/ (open, CC BY-NC-ND 3.0)

may_be_used_for: At most a supporting check that is pre-registered before any ECHT simulation: sustainment at 180-220 V and 2.06 mg/s; I_d magnitude and its decrease with coil current; thrust ~20-23 mN. Forced assumptions A1-A11 are carried as declared layer-1 nuisance.
Context for the published ECHT operating envelope (180-220 V, 2.06 mg/s N2), quoted with its evidence class.
must_not_be_used_for: a transport discriminator: it cannot promote, eliminate or rank screening candidates or admitted members
a score-bearing validation result, or any gate-3 pass/fail
tuning or retuning any transport closure, chemistry or boundary condition
replacement simulation cases: none were created, and none may be created under this status
the 250 V anchor or the 225-275 V points as evidence of ECHT behaviour
disposition.supporting_check_note: No ECHT supporting check is pre-registered. As of 2026-09-26, no file in hallthruster_bridge/prereg/ defines an ECHT criterion. Creating one is an owner decision, and it must be frozen before any ECHT simulation.
forced_assumptions: A1 channel radii: 100 mm = channel OD (r 40/50 mm) vs BN piece OD (unknown wall thickness)
A2 anode axial position and the B(z) axis origin (exit at 86 vs 87.3 mm)
A3 B magnitude per run: FEMM interpolated in coil current, scaled (or not) by the single 2 A measured/FEMM ratio; 0.8 A extrapolated; radial position/component of the measured profile
A4 B(z) beyond 10.1-10.3 cm (plume region of the 1-D domain)
A5 cathode: neglect the argon cathode flow (7-36 % of anode mass) and choose a cathode coupling voltage/position
A6 facility: background pressure/ingestion model (0.8-2.5e-4 Torr, no published correction; comparison mode facility vs vacuum)
A7 thrust reduction reading (one-side vs averaged, 6-18 %) and a total thrust uncertainty (published +- are fit-only)
A8 plume divergence (no data) for any thrust comparison
A9 anode flow 2.06 vs 2.083 mg/s (1 %) and I_d uncertainty (rounding only)
A11 treatment of the strongly unstable runs (1, 3, 7) and of mode changes during calibration (I_d possibly not simultaneous with thrust)

unsupported: exit-peaked Gaussian B(z) (contradicted by the published flat plateau); B_max_T null
no coil current per case, so no case matches a tabulated S2 operating point
